warnings: This sheet details F3 and F4, but the S-01 footing plan places only F1 and F2. S-04 (which would carry F1/F2) is not in the downloaded set. The F1/F2 drawn on S-01 scale to the same sizes and pile layouts as F3/F4 here (F1 = 1.20 x 1.20 / 9 piles, F2 = 1.65 x 1.20 / 12 piles); marks are kept as printed on each sheet and no spec is copied across — the join is recorded as a warning only.
Pile caps on I-section piles I 0.15 x 0.15, 6.00 m long (F3: 9 piles, F4: 12 piles); no safe load printed. main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b). F3 is square, so depth_mm is omitted.
Depths below ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 to the cap top, cap 0.30 / 0.35, lean concrete 0.05, sand 0.05) are printed against a level with no value, so they stay on the elements.
